title: Pick up a keycard and open the airlock
setup: Walking over the keycard with a body in the `player` group puts it in the first position with enough space. Press **Open Airlock** to consume the card and clear the exit.

title: Spend scrap to repair a bridge
setup: Press **Repair Bridge** to commit the scrap cost and the repair together. On success, the barricade disappears and the supply label shows the remaining scrap.

title: Rest at a checkpoint and retry after leaving the safe room
setup: Press **Rest** in the safe room, then **Enter Mines** and **Retry** to return to the saved room. Keep the campaign controller outside both world scenes so it survives the swap.

title: Load the caves when the player crosses the village gate
setup: When a body in the `player` group crosses the village gate, the loader swaps the village for the caves. Keep the player, camera, and gate outside the world container.

title: Control a repair drone's work light
setup: Press **Toggle Work Light** while controlling the pilot to see the command rejected. Switch to the repair drone and press it again to turn on the light.
